page.overview:
Who is Jake the Dog?

Jake the Dog is an Adventure Time minifigure introduced in 2016 as part of LEGO Dimensions.

Jake is the son of a shapeshifter who planted its egg on the head of Joshua the dog. Joshua and his wife Margaret raised Jake as their son, since he looked just like them, and currently Jake helps Joshua and Margaret's other adopted son, Finn the Human.

Jake the Dog is a purchasable skin in-game for 1,500 V-Bucks or with the Adventure Time Bundle for 3,800 V-Bucks.
